name: amplifier-capability-idea-talks

engine_components.browser_controls: New deterministic standalone HTML editor/exporter; no model, server or publishing service.

promise: Turn authorized evidence into one idea, one concrete example and one invitation in a self-contained HTML talk.

portable_method.name: idea-talks
portable_method.contract: Read and apply in the caller's existing context; no independent model or publishing loop.

portable.input: Idea, audience, chosen speaker words, authorized source pack, intended privacy/audience, explicit output location.
portable.output: Self-contained HTML talk and adjacent story-evidence.md; unresolved claims remain visible.
portable.failure: If evidence cannot support the idea, return an honest question or proposed example instead of inventing results; leave unsupported public claims out.

installation.scope: Shared canonical portable installer only; destination preview and explicit apply.

runtime.writes: Explicitly selected local draft outputs; browser draft when editing.
runtime.outbound: None provided by the package. Source-credit links navigate only on user action. Publishing/model transfers require the caller's independent authorization.

dataflow.method: Caller supplies authorized evidence to its already selected host/model; this skill provisions no provider or credentials.
dataflow.template: Inline HTML/CSS/JavaScript, system font fallbacks, no runtime fetch. Browser edits may use localStorage. Download includes slide notes and source details; inspect before sharing.
dataflow.publication: Not implemented; draft completion does not publish or approve sharing.

source_policy.revision: Use an explicit full Git commit with the existing shared canonical installer; no latest inference.
source_policy.research: .research/market remains local and ignored; AGENTS.md governs refresh.
source_policy.rights: MIT for the distributed method, code and included generic assets; supplied source material retains its own rights and privacy limits.
source_policy.legacy: The legacy installed skill is not replaced automatically. This release uses newly authored method and HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with no inherited template/art/font assets.

optional_tests: Existing Playwright and compatible Chromium, explicitly selected by test operator; no implicit installation.

guide_publication_status: Coordinated main-site guide; repository owner controls publication.
version_basis: Initial MIT package; scoped verification does not imply writing quality or independent human usefulness.
publication_status: Publication is a separate owner operation; this capability only prepares local drafts.
